request.brief: Impeccable Read mode: source-grounded social news carousel1080x1350. White/charcoal/cool-gray with restrained navy text. Distinct content-led compositions: wide workspace cover, side office scene with attributed speech paraphrase, learning photo over three policy directions, financial paperwork alongside support priorities, laptop with reminder to consult separate notices. Genuine contextual stock photography on every page, prominent 자료사진 notice below photo, not portraits or fabricated events. Preserve photo frames with contain, separate text by24px, Noto700/450 actual glyph shapes and main body44px+. No ornamental lines/fake data or implied enacted funding. Exact Korean copy and factual basis as supplied.
